author: K. L. Pryor
title: Bear Cave Intermediate School sees 153 5th-graders participate in 2024-25 mathematics MCA
text:
Fifth-grade students at Bear Cave Intermediate School had the highest participation in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA, the Minnesota Department of Education reported.
Of the 437 students who sat for the mathematics assessment at Bear Cave Intermediate School, 153 were fifth-graders.
According to the test standards, 48% of participating fifth-grade students met proficiency in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state-administered exams that measure student achievement against Minnesota’s academic standards and satisfy both state and federal legislative mandates. Tests may include math, reading, and science, depending on grade level. Most students take the MCA, while eligible students receiving special education services may take the Alt MCA.
Proficiency rates on Minnesota’s MCA exams have decreased compared to pre-pandemic figures , according to Minnesota’s Report Card. Mathematics proficiency fell by more than 7% since 2019, and reading proficiency dropped by nearly 5%.
